title: Density-one regularity (Simon 5.7.1, first assertion)
statement: If n >= 1, U is open, V = v(M,theta) has generalized mean curvature H in U, p > n, H is locally in L^p(mu_V) on U, theta >= 1 mu_V-a.e., xi in U and Theta^n(mu_V, xi) = 1, then there are rho > 0, a linear isometry Q of R^(n+l), an open W in R^n containing 0 and u: R^n -> R^l with IsHolderCkα 1 (1 - n/p) u W (C^{1,1-n/p}(W) with bounded u, Du), u(0) = 0, fderiv u 0 = 0 and H^n((Q(M - xi) cap open B_rho(0)) symmetric-difference graph_W u) = 0.
